title.narrative: Resilience and Wellbeing of Ukrainian Media Professionals at Wartime

description.narrative:
This project aims to address the urgent needs of Ukrainian media professionals affected by the ongoing armed conflict.

The National commission requested US$ 49,852, to help media professionals with a strong focus on women and persons with disabilities or those who have lost their physical or mental health while performing their duties under the armed conflict with Russia, by organizing meeting and workshops on professional rehabilitation. 30 media professionals will benefit directly from this project.
